einzeiler: Psychic medium Barbara Banner on how everyone can access intuition and spirit guides.
kurzfassung: Psychic medium Barbara Banner discusses her unexpected awakening during the pandemic and explains how she communicates with deceased loved ones. She shares stories of specific readings, details the concept of pre-birth soul contracts, and explains how anyone can develop their own intuitive abilities. The conversation also explores the therapeutic role of humor and laughter in processing grief.
stichpunkte: Barbara Banner experienced a paranormal awakening in her home during the pandemic, leading her to study mediumship with Suzanne Giesemann.
She describes mediumship as lowering spirit vibration while raising her own to meet in the middle and relay messages.
Banner believes that everyone possesses the tools to be a medium through meditation and openness.
Before becoming a full-time medium, she worked on crisis hotlines and emergency response teams, building a high tolerance for emotional intensity.
She emphasizes that souls make pre-birth contracts and choose life lessons, viewing challenges and suffering as opportunities for soul growth.
Humor is frequently incorporated into her readings because laughter raises vibrational energy and provides relief during grief.
She shares a striking story of a skeptical client whose deceased husband messaged her about a bagel scooping prototype before it was revealed.
Recommended resources for exploring the spirit world include meditation, near-death experience accounts, and educational websites like soulproof.com.

clips.hook: Put on ice for decades before being reactivated
clips.text: The guest humorously describes her latent psychic abilities as having been put on hold for many years before suddenly being switched back on.

clips.hook: Standing beside deceased bodies when families arrive
clips.text: The guest recounts her volunteer work responding to death scenes alongside police officers to comfort grieving families.

clips.hook: Fifteen minutes of laughter equals restorative sleep
clips.text: The guest cites the physiological benefits of laughing as a powerful tool to interrupt heavy emotional pain during mourning.

beschreibung:
What if your intuition isn't just a gut feeling, but a message from Spirit? What if the challenges you're facing today were lessons your soul chose before you were even born? And what if anyone could learn to connect with loved ones who have passed?

In this episode of Mayim Bialik's Breakdown, Barbra Banner (Certified Psychic, Trance & Evidential Medium) shares the extraordinary story of how she unexpectedly became a medium during the pandemic, despite having no previous interest in psychic abilities or mediumship. After experiencing intense paranormal activity in her own home, her life changed forever.

Barbra reveals how she discovered that her gifts run in her family, how her loved ones reacted to her transformation, and how she learned to raise her vibration to connect with Spirit and deliver healing messages from deceased loved ones to help clients find comfort and peace after loss.

She also explains why she believes intuition may actually be Spirit communicating with us, why Spirit often speaks through symbolism instead of words, and how anyone can strengthen their own connection with loved ones on the other side.

You'll also hear her powerful perspective on "Earth School" - the belief that our souls choose certain life lessons and challenges before coming into this lifetime - and why understanding your soul contract can completely change how you view suffering, purpose, and personal growth.

Barbra discusses what it's really like to channel someone you had a difficult or contentious relationship with during life, why she believes there are only 3 emotions experienced on the other side—love, gratitude, and joy—and why mediumship and after-death communication are becoming more accepted around the world.

She also shares how years of volunteering on crisis hotlines unknowingly prepared her to develop her mediumship, why belief often precedes spiritual experiences, and offers thoughtful advice for skeptics who are curious but unsure what to believe.

Whether you're interested in mediumship, psychic phenomena, intuition, spirituality, life after death, near death experiences, consciousness, or connecting with deceased loved ones, this conversation offers a thought-provoking look at one woman's remarkable journey!
